origin:
23XI Racing's story began in the garages of Kannapolis, North Carolina, not in the boardrooms of corporate giants. It was the brainchild of Denny Hamlin, a seasoned racer with a burning desire to cultivate young talent, and Michael Jordan, the basketball icon seeking a new challenge in the world of motorsports. Initially dismissed as a vanity project by some, the team quickly proved its mettle by securing Bubba Wallace as their first driver, signaling a commitment to diversity and forward-thinking initiatives. The early days were a whirlwind of late nights, cobbled-together equipment, and a relentless pursuit of speed, fueled by a shared vision of challenging the established order.

The pivotal moment came during the 2021 season at Talladega Superspeedway. Against all odds, and amidst treacherous conditions, Bubba Wallace piloted the 23XI Racing entry to a stunning victory. The win not only validated the team's existence but also served as a beacon of hope, demonstrating that with the right combination of talent, determination, and a bit of luck, even an upstart team could compete with the best in the sport. This triumph provided the foundation upon which 23XI Racing would build its future, proving that dreams could be realized even with limited resources and basic facilities.
philosophy: 23XI Racing operates on a philosophy of calculated risk and unwavering belief in its people. The team's approach to car development is rooted in data analysis and driver feedback, leveraging technology to maximize performance within the constraints of its budget. The team culture is one of empowerment and collaboration, fostering an environment where every member feels valued and encouraged to contribute their unique skills and perspectives.
achievements: Consistent top-20 finishes in the NASCAR Cup Series
Successful implementation of data-driven performance improvements

teamPrincipal.name: Steve Lauletta
teamPrincipal.background: Steve Lauletta brings extensive marketing and management experience to 23XI Racing, having worked with major brands in NASCAR. His calm demeanor and strategic vision provide a steady hand in guiding the team's operations and partnerships.

keyFigures.name: Bootie Barker
keyFigures.description: Bootie Barker is a veteran crew chief known for his tactical acumen and ability to extract maximum performance from his drivers and equipment. He is highly respected within the garage for his experience and calm demeanor under pressure.

keyFigures.name: Mike Wheeler
keyFigures.description: Mike Wheeler brings a wealth of experience to the team, overseeing all aspects of racing operations and ensuring that the team is competitive on the track. His strategic insights and leadership are instrumental in driving the team's success.

headquarters: 23XI Racing is based in a modest facility in Kannapolis, North Carolina. While the facilities are basic, the team has invested heavily in technology and personnel to maximize its competitive edge.
fanBase: 23XI Racing's fan base is a diverse and passionate group of supporters drawn to the team's commitment to diversity, social justice, and its underdog spirit. They are known for their unwavering loyalty and enthusiastic support, both at the track and online.
